empty.title: Nothing cleared yet.
empty.body: Start with the senders in your inbox. See how much each one sends and how much of it is marked read, then choose what to do with them.

queued.title: Your scan is waiting to start.
queued.body: It starts on its own and keeps anything already scanned. You don’t need to keep this page open.

syncing.title: Scanning your Gmail…
syncing.body: You can close this tab and come back later.

largest.body: About {size} of email (Gmail’s estimates). Archiving doesn’t change storage. Deleting moves email to Gmail Trash, which Gmail empties after 30 days.
